system.description: MindSight allows the psychic to read another’s surface thoughts. Note that surface thoughts are only what is occupying the target’s attention at that moment, and rarely involve long-range plans, habitual behavior or detailed recollections. Language barriers can get in the way, as can differences in the psychology of alien races from beyond the Known Worlds. A level 5 version of this power, MindSearch, allows the psychic to delve deeper, into the target’s deepest thoughts and memories.
